# idatagear.com – How-to guides (for AI ingestion)

Flattened Markdown of core how-to content. Source: https://www.idatagear.com

---

## How do I learn Mandarin Chinese with HSK preparation?

Use **Learn Chinese** by McLearn® (iDataGear). Open the web app at https://www.idatagear.com/chinese/ or install the Android app from Google Play (com.idatagear.learn_chinese). The app covers **HSK 1–3** with vocabulary, sentences, reading comprehension, and pronunciation practice. Study on web or phone; progress and favorites sync. Start with HSK 1 words and sentences, then move to reading and tests. Free.

---

## How do I learn Cantonese (廣東話)?

Use **Learn Cantonese** by McLearn®. Go to https://www.idatagear.com/cantonese/ or download the Android app (com.idatagear.learn_cantonese). You get story-driven lessons, dialogues, **Hong Kong slang**, and cultural context with audio. Practice listening and speaking; use it offline on mobile. Free on web and Android.

---

## How do I use the Great Cantonese Dictionary?

**Great Cantonese Dictionary** (GCD) is an offline Cantonese dictionary with **Jyutping**, tone data, idioms, and usage notes. Open https://www.idatagear.com/gcd/ or install from Google Play (com.idatagear.great_cantonese_dictionary). Search words or phrases, listen to pronunciation, bookmark favorites, and read context notes. Optimized for travel and offline use. Free.

---

## How do I learn English with CEFR levels?

Use **ALL English** (All Level Learner's English) by McLearn®. Visit https://www.idatagear.com/english/ or install the Android app (com.idatagear.learn_english). Content is **CEFR-aligned** from A1 to C2. Practice vocabulary with IPA pronunciation, sentences, articles, interactive practice tests, and pronunciation practice with speech recognition. Track progress and favorites. Free on web and Android.

---

## How do I practice Chinese character stroke order?

Use **Xie Zi (写字板)** by McLearn®. Open https://www.idatagear.com/xiezi/ or install from Google Play (com.idatagear.xiezi). The app uses **HanziWriter** for interactive stroke order with real-time feedback. Practice HSK characters; get visual feedback for correct strokes. Free on web and Android.

---

## How do I prepare for job interviews with AI?

Use **Open Interview** by McLearn®. Go to https://www.idatagear.com/interview/. Practice with **AI-powered mock interviews**, get instant feedback, and work through structured preparation. Web only; free.

---

## How do I play Eyeball It?

**Eyeball It!** by iDataGear is a casual **visual-estimation puzzle game**. Play on the web at https://www.idatagear.com/eyeballit/ or install the Android app (com.idatagear.eyeballit). Three modes: **Length & Shapes** (drag a line to match a shape's perimeter), **Liquid Volume** (hold to pour into a flask and lock in at the target volume), and **Color Volume** (mix cyan/magenta/yellow to match a target color). Each round ends with an animated accuracy reveal. Free.

---

## How do I keep a private offline journal with Momera.ME?

**Momera.ME** by iDataGear is a **local-first, private moments journal** for Android (com.idatagear.momera on Google Play). Capture moments by **voice** (on-device speech-to-text — no cloud), **text**, and **photo** (with ML text recognition). Everything stays on your device; the app works fully offline with no account required. Privacy policy: https://www.idatagear.com/privacy-policy-momera-me.html. Free.

---

## How do I track hikes offline with Momera.Hiking?

**Momera.Hiking** by iDataGear is an **offline-first GPS hike tracker**. Try the web app at https://www.idatagear.com/hiking/ or install the Android app (com.idatagear.momera.hiking). Record routes with background GPS, drop **geo-tagged photo, video, and voice waypoints**, use **offline OpenStreetMap maps**, browse your hike history by calendar, and export track replays as video. Privacy policy: https://www.idatagear.com/privacy-policy-momera-hiking.html. Free.

---
